We have functional groups list. For Doebner modification, functional groups formed: "C-C double bonds" and "carboxylic acid" (maybe aromatic carboxylic acid). Broken: "aldehydes", "carboxylic acid" (malonic). Also maybe "C-C single bond" broken? But we can search with functional_groups_broken=["aldehydes","carboxylic acid"] and functional_groups_formed=["C-C double bonds","carboxylic acid"].

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with target molecule SMILES (product). Need product SMILES. Let's construct product SMILES as earlier: "Cc1ccc(N(S(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)c3ccccc3)cc1". We'll use that.
